title: Fake grandchild
summary: A caller pretends to be Ben, Margaret's grandson, in trouble. He asks for secrecy and gift cards.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Grandma? It's me, Ben. I know it's early, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Ben? You sound different. Are you sick?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I have a cold, and I'm in some trouble. I had a car accident and the police are here.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Oh my goodness. Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm okay, but I need your help and I need you not to tell Mom and Dad. They will only panic.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I need you to go to the pharmacy right now and buy five hundred dollars in Apple gift cards.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, it's for the fee, and it has to be done in the next hour or they will take me to jail.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Read me the numbers on the back as soon as you have them. Please don't tell anyone.

payment_attempt.request: Buy a $500 Apple gift card for me, my grandson needs it for a fee.
